outcome: Resolving Karn Liberated's restart ends the game with no winner or loser and begins a new game in which every player starts over.
The player who controlled the restarting ability takes the first turn of the new game.
Every card involved in the old game, including cards brought in from outside the game, is in its owner's library of the new game.
A player with fewer than seven cards in library loses to the state-based check in the first upkeep of the new game.
The restarting effect finishes just before the first untap step, and triggers from it wait for the first priority, usually upkeep.
A card exempted by the restarting effect is not in its owner's deck in the new game.
Restarting a subgame leaves the main game unaffected and main-game references to the subgame's winner or loser use the restarted subgame.
note: Needs Karn Liberated activated inside a Shahrazad subgame
